description: A dynamic, player-driven economy mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric).  Players buy and sell items through an in-game market whose prices shift in real time based on supply and demand. Includes a full coin currency system, per-player transaction history, price trend arrows, achievement-locked items, and extensive server-side configuration.

mods.name: Jake's Economy
mods.description: A dynamic player-driven economy mod with a live market, coin currency, real-time price trends, achievement-locked items, and a fully escrow-backed Auction House.
